<thought>We need a retrosynthetic template for the Peterson reaction, which in the forward direction forms a C=C bond while breaking a C–O (alcohol) and a C–Si (trimethylsilyl) bond. We'll search the template catalog for reactions that form a C=C bond and break an alcohol and a trimethylsilyl group.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
  "functional_groups_formed": ["C=C"],
  "functional_groups_broken": ["alcohol", "trimethylsilyl"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
